151	    private int nextDealerIndex(GameState state) {
152	        int size = state.players().size();
153	        if (state.handNumber() == 0) {
154	            return 0;
155	        }
156	
157	        int current = state.dealerIndex();
158	        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
159	            int candidate = (current + i) % size;

168	    private GameState postBlinds(GameState state, List<GameEvent> events) {
169	        int sbIdx = PlayerTurnManager.smallBlindIndex(state);
170	        int bbIdx = PlayerTurnManager.bigBlindIndex(state);
171	
172	        PlayerState sb = state.players().get(sbIdx);
173	        int sbAmount = Math.min(state.config().smallBlind(), sb.chips());
174	        PlayerState sbPaid = sb.placeBet(sbAmount);
175	        Pot pot = state.pot().addToMain(sbAmount).withCurrentBet(sbAmount);
176	
177	        events.add(new GameEvent.BlindPosted(state.tableId(), sb.id(), sbAmount, true));
178	        state = state.replacePlayer(sbPaid).withPot(pot);
179	
180	        PlayerState bb = state.players().get(bbIdx);
181	        int bbAmount = Math.min(state.config().bigBlind(), bb.chips());
182	        PlayerState bbPaid = bb.placeBet(bbAmount);
183	        Pot potWithBb = state.pot().addToMain(bbAmount).withCurrentBet(bbAmount);
184	
185	        events.add(new GameEvent.BlindPosted(state.tableId(), bb.id(), bbAmount, false));
186	        return state.replacePlayer(bbPaid).withPot(potWithBb);
187	    }

189	    private GameState dealHoleCards(GameState state, List<GameEvent> events) {
190	        List<PlayerState> dealt = new ArrayList<>(state.players());
191	        for (int card = 0; card < 2; card++) {
192	            for (int i = 0; i < dealt.size(); i++) {
193	                PlayerState p = dealt.get(i);
194	                if (!p.status().isInHand()) {
195	                    continue;
196	                }
197	                Card c = state.deck().deal();
198	                List<Card> hand = new ArrayList<>(p.holeCards());
199	                hand.add(c);
200	                dealt.set(i, p.withHoleCards(hand));
201	            }
202	        }
203	
204	        for (PlayerState p : dealt) {
205	            if (p.status().isInHand()) {
206	                events.add(new GameEvent.HoleCardsDealt(state.tableId(), p.id(), p.holeCards()));
207	            }
208	        }
209	
210	        return state.withPlayers(dealt);

package com.friendlypoker.service;

import com.friendlypoker.dto.CreateTableRequest;
import com.friendlypoker.model.*;
import com.friendlypoker.repository.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TableServiceTest {

    @Mock PokerTableRepository tableRepository;
    @Mock ClubRepository clubRepository;
    @Mock ClubMemberRepository clubMemberRepository;
    @Mock TableSeatRepository seatRepository;
    @Mock UserRepository userRepository;

    @InjectMocks
    TableService tableService;

    @Test
    @DisplayName("MEMBER role cannot create table")
    void createTable_memberRole_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        ClubMember member = new ClubMember();
        member.setRole(ClubRole.MEMBER);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(clubMemberRepository.findByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(member));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.createTable(1L,
                new CreateTableRequest("Table", 5, 10, 6, 1000, 30), "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Only owners and admins");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at ACTIVE table")
    void sitDown_tableActive_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.ACTIVE, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("not accepting players");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit twice at same table")
    void sitDown_alreadySeated_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("already seated");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at full table")
    void sitDown_tableFull_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 2);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);
        when(seatRepository.findByTableId(1L)).thenReturn(List.of(new TableSeat(), new TableSeat()));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("full");
    }

    private User makeUser(Long id, String username) {
        User u = new User();
        u.setId(id);
        u.setUsername(username);
        return u;
    }

    private PokerTable makeTable(Long id, TableStatus status, int maxPlayers) {
        PokerTable t = new PokerTable();
        t.setId(id);
        t.setStatus(status);
        t.setMaxPlayers(maxPlayers);
        Club club = new Club();
        club.setId(1L);
        t.setClub(club);
        return t;
    }
}
Зачем: @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) + @Mock + @InjectMocks — чистый unit тест без Spring-контекста, запускается мгновенно. Mockito генерирует заглушки для всех репозиториев. @InjectMocks создаёт TableService и инжектирует моки через конструктор (Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor не мешает — Mockito работает с полями). Тесты проверяют бизнес-правила: кто может садиться, при каких условиях.

Файл 3: src/test/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/engine/GameEngineEdgeCaseTest.java

package com.friendlypoker.engine.engine;

import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.action.GameAction;
import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.GameConfig;
import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.GameState;
import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.PlayerState;
import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.enums.GamePhase;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.AssertionsForClassTypes.assertThatThrownBy;

class GameEngineEdgeCaseTest {

    private GameEngine engine;
    private GameConfig config;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        engine = GameEngineFactory.create();
        config = new GameConfig(5, 10, 2, 9, 1000, 30);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CHECK is rejected when there is a bet to call pre-flop")
    void check_rejectedWhenBetExists() {
        GameState state = twoPlayerHand();
        String current = state.currentPlayer().id();

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> engine.processAction(state, GameAction.check(current)))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RAISE below minimum is rejected")
    void raise_belowMinimum_rejected() {
        GameState state = twoPlayerHand();
        String current = state.currentPlayer().id();
        // currentBet=10, bigBlind=10 → min raise to 20; raising to 15 is invalid
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> engine.processAction(state, GameAction.raise(current, 15)))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("minimum raise");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("After raise, opponent must re-act before round ends")
    void raise_forcesOpponentToAct() {
        GameState state = twoPlayerHand();
        String first = state.currentPlayer().id();
        state = engine.processAction(state, GameAction.raise(first, 30)).newState();

        // Round is NOT over after a single raise — opponent must still act
        assertThat(state.phase()).isEqualTo(GamePhase.PRE_FLOP);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Dealer rotates on second hand")
    void secondHand_dealerRotates() {
        GameState state = twoPlayerHand();
        int firstDealer = state.dealerIndex();

        // Finish hand by folding
        state = engine.processAction(state, GameAction.fold(state.currentPlayer().id())).newState();
        assertThat(state.phase()).isEqualTo(GamePhase.FINISHED);

        state = engine.startHand(state).newState();
        assertThat(state.dealerIndex()).isNotEqualTo(firstDealer);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Total chips conserved through an entire hand with a raise")
    void chipsConserved_withRaise() {
        GameState state = twoPlayerHand();
        // raise → call → check × 3 rounds → showdown
        String p1 = state.currentPlayer().id();
        state = engine.processAction(state, GameAction.raise(p1, 30)).newState();
        state = engine.processAction(state, GameAction.call(state.currentPlayer().id())).newState();

        while (state.phase().isBettingPhase()) {
            state = engine.processAction(state, GameAction.check(state.currentPlayer().id())).newState();
        }

        assertThat(state.phase()).isEqualTo(GamePhase.FINISHED);
        int total = state.players().stream().mapToInt(PlayerState::chips).sum();
        assertThat(total).isEqualTo(2000);
    }

    private GameState twoPlayerHand() {
        GameState state = engine.createGame("t1", config);
        state = engine.addPlayer(state, "alice", "Alice").newState();
        state = engine.addPlayer(state, "bob", "Bob").newState();
        return engine.startHand(state).newState();
    }
}
Зачем: Дополняет существующий GameEngineIntegrationTest — проверяет edge cases: невалидные действия, принудительный ход после рейза, ротация дилера, сохранение фишек в нестандартном сценарии. twoPlayerHand() — extract method, убирает дублирование setup-кода в каждом тесте. Чистый Java без Spring — запускается без БД и контекста.

// новые импорты:
import org.springframework.validation.FieldError;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex) {
    Map<String, String> fieldErrors = ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream()
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                    FieldError::getField,
                    fe -> fe.getDefaultMessage() != null ? fe.getDefaultMessage() : "invalid",
                    (first, second) -> first
            ));
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(Map.of("errors", fieldErrors));
}

151	    private int nextDealerIndex(GameState state) {

153	        if (state.handNumber() == 0) {

package com.friendlypoker.service;

import com.friendlypoker.dto.CreateTableRequest;
import com.friendlypoker.model.*;
import com.friendlypoker.repository.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TableServiceTest {

    @Mock PokerTableRepository tableRepository;
    @Mock ClubRepository clubRepository;
    @Mock ClubMemberRepository clubMemberRepository;
    @Mock TableSeatRepository seatRepository;
    @Mock UserRepository userRepository;

    @InjectMocks
    TableService tableService;

    @Test
    @DisplayName("MEMBER role cannot create table")
    void createTable_memberRole_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        ClubMember member = new ClubMember();
        member.setRole(ClubRole.MEMBER);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(clubMemberRepository.findByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(member));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.createTable(1L,
                new CreateTableRequest("Table", 5, 10, 6, 1000, 30), "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Only owners and admins");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at ACTIVE table")
    void sitDown_tableActive_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.ACTIVE, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("not accepting players");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit twice at same table")
    void sitDown_alreadySeated_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("already seated");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at full table")
    void sitDown_tableFull_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 2);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);
        when(seatRepository.findByTableId(1L)).thenReturn(List.of(new TableSeat(), new TableSeat()));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("full");
    }

    private User makeUser(Long id, String username) {
        User u = new User();
        u.setId(id);
        u.setUsername(username);
        return u;
    }

    private PokerTable makeTable(Long id, TableStatus status, int maxPlayers) {

package com.friendlypoker.service;

import com.friendlypoker.dto.CreateTableRequest;
import com.friendlypoker.model.*;
import com.friendlypoker.repository.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;

import org.mockito.InjectMocks;
import org.mockito.Mock;

import java.util.Optional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TableServiceTest {

    @Mock PokerTableRepository tableRepository;
    @Mock ClubRepository clubRepository;
    @Mock ClubMemberRepository clubMemberRepository;
    @Mock TableSeatRepository seatRepository;
    @Mock UserRepository userRepository;

    @InjectMocks

    @DisplayName("MEMBER role cannot create table")
    void createTable_memberRole_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        ClubMember member = new ClubMember();
        member.setRole(ClubRole.MEMBER);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(clubMemberRepository.findByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(member));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.createTable(1L,
                new CreateTableRequest("Table", 5, 10, 6, 1000, 30), "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Only owners and admins");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at ACTIVE table")
    void sitDown_tableActive_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.ACTIVE, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("not accepting players");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit twice at same table")
    void sitDown_alreadySeated_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 6);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("already seated");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Cannot sit at full table")
    void sitDown_tableFull_throwsException() {
        User user = makeUser(1L, "alice");
        PokerTable table = makeTable(1L, TableStatus.WAITING, 2);

        when(userRepository.findByUsername("alice")).thenReturn(Optional.of(user));
        when(tableRepository.findById(1L)).thenReturn(Optional.of(table));
        when(clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(true);
        when(seatRepository.existsByTableIdAndUserId(1L, 1L)).thenReturn(false);
        when(seatRepository.findByTableId(1L)).thenReturn(List.of(new TableSeat(), new TableSeat()));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> tableService.sitDown(1L, "alice"))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("full");
    }

    private User makeUser(Long id, String username) {
        User u = new User();
        u.setId(id);
        u.setUsername(username);
        return u;
    }

    private PokerTable makeTable(Long id, TableStatus status, int maxPlayers) {
        PokerTable t = new PokerTable();
        t.setId(id);
        t.setStatus(status);
        t.setMaxPlayers(maxPlayers);
        Club club = new Club();
        club.setId(1L);
        t.setClub(club);
        return t;
    }
}

## Ответы на твои вопросы

**Браузер → мобильный:** правильный приоритет. Стратегия такая:
- Фаза 1 (сейчас): React-приложение, работает в любом браузере
- Фаза 2 (потом): добавляем **Capacitor** — он оборачивает готовое React-приложение в нативную оболочку без переписывания кода
  - Android APK: собирается с Windows через Android Studio
  - iOS IPA: нет Mac → собирать через **GitHub Actions** (бесплатный macOS-runner) — потом настроим

**Открытый доступ:** это усложняет жизнь — нужен публичный хостинг, домен, HTTPS. Но начнём с локальной разработки, хостинг добавим после.

**Важный момент:** онлайн-покер с реальными деньгами требует лицензии во многих странах. Если фишки виртуальные (без вывода денег) — юридически всё чисто.

import axios from 'axios'

const api = axios.create({ baseURL: '/api' })

api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
  if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
  return config
})

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  (err) => {
    if (err.response?.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem('token')
      window.location.href = '/login'
    }
    return Promise.reject(err)
  }
)

export default api

```

```tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react'

interface AuthState {
  token: string | null
  username: string | null
}

interface AuthContextValue extends AuthState {
  signIn: (token: string, username: string) => void
  signOut: () => void
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null)

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AuthState>({
    token: localStorage.getItem('token'),
    username: localStorage.getItem('username'),
  })

  const signIn = (token: string, username: string) => {
    localStorage.setItem('token', token)
    localStorage.setItem('username', username)
    setState({ token, username })
  }

  const signOut = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('token')
    localStorage.removeItem('username')
    setState({ token: null, username: null })
  }

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ ...state, signIn, signOut }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useAuth() {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider')
  return ctx
}

```

  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const { signIn } = useAuth()
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {

          {error && <p className="text-red-400 text-sm">{error}</p>}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-semibold py-2 rounded-lg transition"

            {loading ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign In'}

        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm text-center mt-4">
          No account?{' '}
          <Link to="/register" className="text-blue-400 hover:underline">
            Register
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react'
import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { register } from '../api/auth'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const { signIn } = useAuth()
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError('')
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await register({ username, email, password })
      signIn(res.token, res.username)
      navigate('/')
    } catch (err: any) {
      const data = err.response?.data
      if (data?.errors) {
        setError(Object.values(data.errors).join(', '))
      } else {
        setError(data?.error ?? 'Registration failed')
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 flex items-center justify-center">
      <div className="bg-gray-800 p-8 rounded-xl w-full max-w-sm shadow-lg">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6 text-center">Create Account</h1>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Username</label>
            <input
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Email</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              minLength={6}
            />
          </div>
          {error && <p className="text-red-400 text-sm">{error}</p>}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-semibold py-2 rounded-lg transition"
          >
            {loading ? 'Creating account...' : 'Register'}
          </button>
        </form>
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm text-center mt-4">
          Already have an account?{' '}
          <Link to="/login" className="text-blue-400 hover:underline">
            Sign In
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import Navbar from '../components/Navbar'
import { getMyClubs, createClub, joinByInvite, ClubResponse } from '../api/clubs'

export default function LobbyPage() {
  const [clubs, setClubs] = useState<ClubResponse[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false)
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  const [newDesc, setNewDesc] = useState('')
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false)

  const [inviteToken, setInviteToken] = useState('')
  const [joining, setJoining] = useState(false)
  const [joinError, setJoinError] = useState('')

  const navigate = useNavigate()

  useEffect(() => {
    getMyClubs()
      .then(setClubs)
      .catch(() => setError('Failed to load clubs'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [])

  async function handleCreate(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setCreating(true)
    try {
      const club = await createClub({ name: newName, description: newDesc })
      setClubs((prev) => [...prev, club])
      setShowCreate(false)
      setNewName('')
      setNewDesc('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error ?? 'Failed to create club')
    } finally {
      setCreating(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleJoin(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setJoining(true)
    setJoinError('')
    try {
      const club = await joinByInvite(inviteToken.trim())
      setClubs((prev) => {
        if (prev.find((c) => c.id === club.id)) return prev
        return [...prev, club]
      })
      setInviteToken('')
    } catch (err: any) {
      setJoinError(err.response?.data?.error ?? 'Invalid invite')
    } finally {
      setJoining(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white">
      <Navbar />
      <main className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-8">

        {/* My clubs */}
        <section>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">My Clubs</h2>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowCreate(!showCreate)}
              className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition"
            >
              + New Club
            </button>
          </div>

          {showCreate && (
            <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 mb-4 space-y-3">
              <input
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                placeholder="Club name"
                value={newName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
              <input
                className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                placeholder="Description (optional)"
                value={newDesc}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDesc(e.target.value)}
              />
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={creating}
                  className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:opacity-50 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition"
                >
                  {creating ? 'Creating...' : 'Create'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)}
                  className="bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-500 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {error && <p className="text-red-400 text-sm mb-2">{error}</p>}

          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-gray-400">Loading...</p>
          ) : clubs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-gray-400">You are not in any clubs yet.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {clubs.map((club) => (
                <div
                  key={club.id}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/clubs/${club.id}`)}
                  className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-700 transition flex justify-between items-center"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-semibold">{club.name}</p>
                    {club.description && (
                      <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">{club.description}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-xs">Owner: {club.ownerUsername}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Join by invite */}
        <section>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Join by Invite</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleJoin} className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="Paste invite code..."
              value={inviteToken}
              onChange={(e) => setInviteToken(e.target.value)}
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={joining || !inviteToken.trim()}
              className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition"
            >
              {joining ? 'Joining...' : 'Join'}
            </button>
          </form>
          {joinError && <p className="text-red-400 text-sm mt-1">{joinError}</p>}
        </section>

      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import Navbar from '../components/Navbar'
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'
import { getMyClubs, createInvite, ClubResponse } from '../api/clubs'
import { getClubTables, createTable, sitDown, standUp, TableResponse } from '../api/tables'

export default function ClubPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>()
  const clubId = Number(id)
  const { username } = useAuth()

  const [club, setClub] = useState<ClubResponse | null>(null)
  const [tables, setTables] = useState<TableResponse[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false)
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    smallBlind: 5,
    bigBlind: 10,
    maxPlayers: 6,
    startingChips: 1000,
    actionTimeoutSecs: 30,
  })
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false)

  const [inviteLink, setInviteLink] = useState('')
  const [copyLabel, setCopyLabel] = useState('Copy')

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      getMyClubs().then((clubs) => clubs.find((c) => c.id === clubId) ?? null),
      getClubTables(clubId),
    ])
      .then(([c, t]) => { setClub(c); setTables(t) })
      .catch(() => setError('Failed to load club data'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [clubId])

  async function handleCreateTable(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setCreating(true)
    try {
      const table = await createTable(clubId, form)
      setTables((prev) => [...prev, table])
      setShowCreate(false)
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error ?? 'Failed to create table')
    } finally {
      setCreating(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleGenerateInvite() {
    try {
      const { token } = await createInvite(clubId)
      setInviteLink(token)
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to generate invite')
    }
  }

  async function handleCopy() {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(inviteLink)
    setCopyLabel('Copied!')
    setTimeout(() => setCopyLabel('Copy'), 2000)
  }

  async function handleSit(tableId: number) {
    try {
      const updated = await sitDown(tableId)
      setTables((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.id === tableId ? updated : t)))
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error ?? 'Failed to sit')
    }
  }

  async function handleStand(tableId: number) {
    try {
      await standUp(tableId)
      setTables((prev) =>
        prev.map((t) =>
          t.id === tableId
            ? { ...t, seats: t.seats.filter((s) => s.username !== username) }
            : t
        )
      )
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error ?? 'Failed to stand')
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white">
        <Navbar />
        <p className="p-6 text-gray-400">Loading...</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const isOwner = club?.ownerUsername === username

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white">
      <Navbar />
      <main className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-8">

        {/* Club header */}
        <section className="flex justify-between items-start">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">{club?.name ?? 'Club'}</h2>
            {club?.description && (
              <p className="text-gray-400 mt-1">{club.description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleGenerateInvite}
            className="bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-sm px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition"
          >
            Generate Invite
          </button>
        </section>

        {/* Invite link */}
        {inviteLink && (
          <section className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex gap-2 items-center">
            <input
              readOnly
              value={inviteLink}
              className="flex-1 bg-gray-700 text-white text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none"
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition"
            >
              {copyLabel}
            </button>
          </section>
        )}

        {error && <p className="text-red-400 text-sm">{error}</p>}

        {/* Tables */}
        <section>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold">Tables</h3>
            {isOwner && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowCreate(!showCreate)}
                className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition"
              >
                + New Table
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {showCreate && (
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateTable} className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 mb-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Table name</label>
                  <input
                    className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                    value={form.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                {[
                  { label: 'Small Blind', key: 'smallBlind' },
                  { label: 'Big Blind', key: 'bigBlind' },
                  { label: 'Max Players', key: 'maxPlayers' },
                  { label: 'Starting Chips', key: 'startingChips' },
                  { label: 'Action Timeout (sec)', key: 'actionTimeoutSecs' },
                ].map(({ label, key }) => (
                  <div key={key}>
                    <label className="block text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">{label}</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      className="w-full bg-gray-700 text-white rounded-lg px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                      value={(form as any)[key]}
                      onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, [key]: Number(e.target.value) })}
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={creating}
                  className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:opacity-50 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition"
                >
                  {creating ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Table'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCreate(false)}
                  className="bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-500 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}

          {tables.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-gray-400">No tables yet.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {tables.map((table) => {
                const isSeated = table.seats.some((s) => s.username === username)
                const isFull = table.seats.length >= table.maxPlayers
                const isWaiting = table.status === 'WAITING'

                return (
                  <div key={table.id} className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <div>
                        <p className="font-semibold">{table.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">
                          {table.smallBlind}/{table.bigBlind} blinds · {table.seats.length}/{table.maxPlayers} players · {table.startingChips} chips
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                          table.status === 'WAITING' ? 'bg-green-800 text-green-300' :
                          table.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'bg-blue-800 text-blue-300' :
                          'bg-gray-700 text-gray-300'
                        }`}>
                          {table.status}
                        </span>
                        {isSeated ? (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleStand(table.id)}
                            className="bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-600 text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition"
                          >
                            Stand Up
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          isWaiting && !isFull && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleSit(table.id)}
                              className="bg-green-700 hover:bg-green-600 text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition"
                            >
                              Sit Down
                            </button>
                          )
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {table.seats.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {table.seats.map((seat) => (
                          <span
                            key={seat.seatIndex}
                            className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                              seat.username === username
                                ? 'bg-blue-700 text-blue-200'
                                : 'bg-gray-700 text-gray-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {seat.username} ({seat.chips})
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

```

## Summary: WebSocket and Game-Related Source Files

I've completed a thorough exploration of the FriendlyPoker codebase and found all WebSocket-related and game-related source files. Here's what I discovered:

### 1. WebSocket Configuration

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/config/WebSocketConfig.java`

This is the central WebSocket configuration file with:
- `@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker` annotation enabling STOMP over WebSocket
- Simple broker configured for `/topic` prefix (broadcast messages)
- Application destination prefix set to `/app` (client to server messages)
- STOMP endpoint registered at `/ws` with SockJS fallback support
- CORS allowing all origins (`*` pattern)

**Key WebSocket Paths:**
- `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` - broadcasts game state updates
- `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` - broadcasts game events

---

### 2. Game Controllers (REST APIs for Game Actions)

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/controller/GameController.java`

REST endpoints (not using `@MessageMapping`, so game actions go through REST/HTTP):
- `POST /api/tables/{id}/start-hand` - starts a new hand
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/state` - retrieves current game state
- `POST /api/tables/{id}/action` - processes player actions (fold, check, call, raise, all-in)
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/history` - retrieves hand history
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/actions` - gets available actions for current player

---

### 3. Game Service (Core Game Logic & WebSocket Broadcasting)

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/service/GameService.java`

The service that orchestrates game flow and broadcasts updates:
- Processes player actions via `processAction()` method
- Starts hands via `startHand()` method
- Uses `SimpMessagingTemplate` to broadcast game state and events to WebSocket topics
- Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` after each action
- Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` for game events (excluding HoleCardsDealt for privacy)
- Saves hand history when hands finish
- Manages GameSession lifecycle

---

### 4. Game Session Management

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/game/GameSession.java`

Manages a single table's game state:
- Wraps the GameEngine with synchronization
- Provides methods: `startHand()`, `processAction()`, `getState()`
- Thread-safe state management

**File 2:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/game/GameSessionManager.java`

Manages all active game sessions:
- Uses `ConcurrentHashMap<Long, GameSession>` to store sessions by table ID
- Methods: `getOrCreate()`, `get()`, `remove()`
- Spring `@Component` for dependency injection

---

### 5. Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for Game State & Actions

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/dto/GameStateView.java`

The main DTO sent over WebSocket to clients (represents game state):

    Long handNumber,
    String phase,
    List<PlayerView> players,
    int potTotal,
    int currentBet,
    List<CardView> communityCards,
    int dealerIndex,
    int currentPlayerIndex
)
```
- Nested `PlayerView` with player details (id, displayName, chips, status, currentBet, seatIndex, holeCards)
- Nested `CardView` with card rank and suit
- Includes visibility logic (only shows hole cards to the viewing player or during showdown)

**File 2:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/dto/ActionRequest.java`

Client-to-server DTO for player actions:

    @NotBlank String type,      // FOLD, CHECK, CALL, RAISE, ALL_IN
    @Min(0) int amount
)
```

**File 3:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/dto/GameEventView.java`

DTO for game events sent over WebSocket:
```java

```
- Type is the event class name (e.g., "PlayerActed", "BlindPosted")
- Data is the actual GameEvent object

**File 4:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/dto/AvailableActionResponse.java`

DTO that tells clients which actions are available:
```java

    boolean yourTurn,
    String currentPlayerId,
    List<ActionOption> actions
)
```
- Nested `ActionOption` with type, amount, and description
- Intelligently calculates available actions based on game state (fold, check/call, raise options, all-in)

---

### 6. Game Domain Models

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/action/GameAction.java`

Represents a player action in the game:
```java

    String playerId,
    ActionType type,     // FOLD, CHECK, CALL, RAISE, ALL_IN
    int amount
)
```
- Factory methods: `fold()`, `check()`, `call()`, `raise()`, `allIn()`
- Validation in compact constructor

**File 2:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/event/GameEvent.java`

Sealed interface defining all game events with 15 record implementations:
- `HandStarted` - hand begins
- `HoleCardsDealt` - hole cards dealt to player
- `BlindPosted` - blind posted by player
- `PhaseChanged` - game phase changed (PreFlop → Flop → Turn → River → Showdown)
- `CommunityCardDealt` - community cards revealed
- `PlayerActed` - player made action with amount and chips remaining
- `PlayerFolded` - player folded
- `BettingRoundCompleted` - betting round finished
- `Showdown` - showdown phase with revealed hands and ranks
- `PotAwarded` - pot awarded to winner
- `HandFinished` - hand completed with chip deltas for all players
- `PlayerJoined`, `PlayerLeft`, `PlayerSatOut`, `PlayerTimedOut` - player status events

**File 3:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/model/GameState.java`

Core game state model (immutable record):
```java
record GameState(
    String tableId,
    long handNumber,
    GamePhase phase,
    List<PlayerState> players,
    Deck deck,
    Pot pot,
    List<Card> communityCards,
    int dealerIndex,
    int currentPlayerIndex,
    GameConfig config
)
```
- Methods: `findPlayer()`, `currentPlayer()`, `dealer()`, `activePlayers()`, `isBettingRoundComplete()`, etc.
- Immutable with builder-pattern methods like `withPhase()`, `withPlayers()`, `replacePlayer()`

---

### WebSocket Communication Flow

1. **Client connects** → WebSocket handshake at `/ws`
2. **Client subscribes** → Client subscribes to:
   - `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` (game state updates)
   - `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` (game events)
3. **Player action** → Client sends HTTP POST to `/api/tables/{id}/action`
4. **Server processes** → `GameService.processAction()`:
   - Converts `ActionRequest` to `GameAction`
   - Calls `GameSession.processAction()`
   - Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` with new `GameStateView`
   - Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` with game events
5. **Clients receive** → All subscribed clients receive broadcasted updates

### Important Notes

- **No `@MessageMapping` handlers** - Game actions use traditional REST API (`POST /api/tables/{id}/action`) rather than STOMP message mapping
- **Broadcasting strategy** - Uses `SimpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend()` to push updates to all clients
- **Privacy handling** - Hole cards only shown to the player who holds them (or all players during showdown)
- **Thread safety** - `GameSession` uses `synchronized` methods to ensure thread-safe state transitions

24	        GameResult result = engine.processAction(state, action);
25	        state = result.newState();

9	public record GameStateView(
10	        Long tableId,
11	        Long handNumber,
12	        String phase,
13	        List<PlayerView> players,
14	        int potTotal,
15	        int currentBet,
16	        List<CardView> communityCards,
17	        int dealerIndex,
18	        int currentPlayerIndex
19	) {

21	        public static CardView from(Card c) {
22	            return new CardView(c.rank().name(), c.suit().name());
23	        }
24	    }
25	
26	    public record PlayerView(
27	            String id,
28	            String displayName,
29	            int chips,
30	            String status,
31	            int currentBet,
32	            int seatIndex,
33	            List<CardView> holeCards
34	    ) {}
35	
36	    public static GameStateView from(Long tableId, GameState state, String viewerPlayerId) {
37	        boolean showdown = state.phase() == GamePhase.FINISHED || state.phase() == GamePhase.SHOWDOWN;
38	
39	        List<PlayerView> players = state.players().stream().map(p -> {
40	                    boolean isViewer = viewerPlayerId != null && p.id().equals(viewerPlayerId);
41	                    List<CardView> cards = (isViewer || showdown) && p.holeCards() != null
42	                            ? p.holeCards().stream().map(CardView::from).toList()
43	                            : List.of();
44	                    return new PlayerView(
45	                            p.id(),
46	                            p.displayName(),
47	                            p.chips(),
48	                            p.status().name(),
49	                            p.currentBet(),
50	                            p.seatIndex(),
51	                            cards
52	                    );
53	                }).toList();
54	
55	        List<CardView> community = state.communityCards() != null
56	                ? state.communityCards().stream().map(CardView::from).toList()
57	                : List.of();
58	
59	        return new GameStateView(
60	                tableId,
61	                state.handNumber(),
62	                state.phase().name(),
63	                players,
64	                state.pot().total(),
65	                state.pot().currentBet(),
66	                community,
67	                state.dealerIndex(),
68	                state.currentPlayerIndex()
69	        );
70	    }
71	}

1	package com.friendlypoker.dto;
2	
3	import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.GameState;
4	import com.friendlypoker.engine.domain.model.PlayerState;
5	
6	import java.util.ArrayList;
7	import java.util.List;
8	
9	public record AvailableActionResponse(
10	        boolean yourTurn,
11	        String currentPlayerId,
12	        List<ActionOption> actions
13	) {
14	    public record ActionOption(String type, int amount, String description) {}
15	
16	    public static AvailableActionResponse fromState(GameState state, String playerId) {
17	        if(!state.phase().isBettingPhase()) {
18	            return new AvailableActionResponse(false, null, List.of());
19	        }
20	
21	        PlayerState current = state.currentPlayer();
22	        boolean youTurn = current.id().equals(playerId);
23	
24	        if(!youTurn) {
25	            return new AvailableActionResponse(false, null, List.of());
26	        }
27	
28	        List<ActionOption> actions = new ArrayList<>();
29	        int callAmount = Math.min(state.pot().currentBet() - current.currentBet(), current.chips());
30	
31	        actions.add(new ActionOption("FOLD", 0, "fold"));
32	        if (callAmount == 0) {
33	            actions.add(new ActionOption("CHECK", 0, "check"));
34	        } else {
35	            actions.add(new ActionOption("CALL", callAmount, "Call" + callAmount));
36	        }
37	
38	        int minRaiseTo = state.pot().currentBet() + state.config().bigBlind();
39	        int chipsNeededToRaise = minRaiseTo - current.currentBet();
40	        if (chipsNeededToRaise < current.chips()) {
41	            actions.add(new ActionOption("RAISE", minRaiseTo, "Min raise to " + minRaiseTo));
42	        }
43	
44	        if (current.chips() > 0) {
45	            actions.add(new ActionOption("ALL_IN", current.chips(), "All in " + current.chips()));
46	        }
47	
48	        return new AvailableActionResponse(true, current.id(), actions);
49	    }
50	}

18	import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
19	import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
20	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
21	import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
22	
23	import java.util.List;
24	
25	@Service
26	@RequiredArgsConstructor
27	public class GameService {
28	    private final PokerTableRepository tableRepository;
29	    private final TableSeatRepository seatRepository;
30	    private final GameSessionManager sessionManager;
31	    private final SimpMessagingTemplate messaging;
32	    private final UserRepository userRepository;
33	    private final HandHistoryRepository handHistoryRepository;
34	    private final ClubMemberRepository clubMemberRepository;
35	
36	    @Transactional
37	    public GameStateView processAction(Long tableId, ActionRequest req, String username) {
38	        GameSession session = sessionManager.get(tableId);
39	        if (session == null) {
40	            throw new IllegalStateException("No active game at this table");
41	        }
42	
43	        User user = userRepository.findByUsername(username)
44	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found"));
45	
46	        String playerId = user.getId().toString();
47	        ActionType type = ActionType.valueOf(req.type().toUpperCase());
48	
49	        GameAction action = switch (type) {
50	            case FOLD -> GameAction.fold(playerId);
51	            case CHECK -> GameAction.check(playerId);
52	            case RAISE -> GameAction.raise(playerId, req.amount());
53	            case CALL -> GameAction.call(playerId);
54	            case ALL_IN -> GameAction.allIn(playerId, req.amount());
55	        };
56	
57	        GameResult result = session.processAction(action);
58	
59	        if (result.newState().phase() == GamePhase.FINISHED) {
60	            finishGame(tableId, result);
61	        }
62	
63	        broadcast(tableId, result);
64	        return GameStateView.from(tableId, result.newState(), playerId);
65	    }
66	
67	    private void finishGame(Long tableId, GameResult result) {
68	        GameState finalState = result.newState();
69	
70	        result.events().stream()
71	                .filter(e -> e instanceof GameEvent.HandFinished)
72	                .map(e -> (GameEvent.HandFinished) e)
73	                .findFirst()
74	                .ifPresent(e -> saveHandHistory(tableId, e));
75	
76	        List<TableSeat> seats = seatRepository.findByTableId(tableId);
77	        for (TableSeat seat : seats) {
78	            String playerId = seat.getUser().getId().toString();
79	            finalState.findPlayer(playerId).ifPresent(p -> {
80	                seat.setChips(p.chips());
81	                seatRepository.save(seat);
82	            });
83	        }
84	
85	        tableRepository.findById(tableId).ifPresent(t -> {
86	            t.setStatus(TableStatus.WAITING);
87	            tableRepository.save(t);
88	        });
89	        sessionManager.remove(tableId);
90	    }
91	
92	    @Transactional
93	    public GameStateView startHand(Long tableId, String username) {
94	        PokerTable table = tableRepository.findById(tableId)
95	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Table not found"));
96	
97	        User caller = userRepository.findByUsername(username)
98	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found"));
99	
100	        ClubMember member = clubMemberRepository.findByClubIdAndUserId(table.getClub().getId(), caller.getId())
101	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Access denied"));
102	
103	        if (member.getRole() == ClubRole.MEMBER) {
104	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only owners and admins can start a hand");
105	        }
106	
107	        List<TableSeat> seats = seatRepository.findByTableId(tableId);
108	        if (seats.size() < table.getMinPlayers()) {
109	            throw new IllegalStateException("Not enough players");
110	        }
111	
112	        GameConfig config = new GameConfig(
113	                table.getSmallBlind(),
114	                table.getBigBlind(),
115	                table.getMinPlayers(),
116	                table.getMaxPlayers(),
117	                table.getStartingChips(),
118	                table.getActionTimeoutSecs()
119	        );
120	
121	        GameEngine engine = GameEngineFactory.create();
122	        GameState state = engine.createGame(tableId.toString(), config);
123	
124	        for (TableSeat seat : seats) {
125	            GameResult r = engine.addPlayer(
126	                    state,
127	                    seat.getUser().getId().toString(),
128	                    seat.getUser().getUsername()
129	            );
130	            state = r.newState();
131	            PlayerState p = state.findPlayer(seat.getUser().getId().toString()).get();
132	            state = state.replacePlayer(p.withChips(seat.getChips()));
133	        }
134	
135	        GameSession session = new GameSession(engine, state);
136	        sessionManager.getOrCreate(tableId, session);
137	
138	        GameResult result = session.startHand();
139	
140	        table.setStatus(TableStatus.ACTIVE);
141	        tableRepository.save(table);
142	
143	        broadcast(tableId, result);
144	        return GameStateView.from(tableId, result.newState(), null);
145	    }
146	
147	    @Transactional(readOnly = true)

152	        }
153	        User user = userRepository.findByUsername(username)
154	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found"));
155	        return GameStateView.from(tableId, session.getState(), user.getId().toString());
156	    }

158	    private void broadcast(Long tableId, GameResult result) {
159	        String stateTopic = "/topic/tables/" + tableId + "/state";
160	        messaging.convertAndSend(stateTopic, GameStateView.from(tableId, result.newState(), null));
161	
162	        String eventTopic = "/topic/tables/" + tableId + "/events";
163	        result.events().stream()
164	                .filter(e -> !(e instanceof GameEvent.HoleCardsDealt))
165	                .map(GameEventView::from)
166	                .forEach(view -> messaging.convertAndSend(eventTopic, view));
167	    }

169	    private void saveHandHistory(Long tableId, GameEvent.HandFinished event) {
170	        PokerTable table = tableRepository.findById(tableId).orElseThrow();
171	
172	        event.chipDeltas().entrySet().stream()
173	                .filter(entry -> entry.getValue() > 0)
174	                .forEach(entry -> {
175	                    HandHistory history = new HandHistory();
176	                    history.setTable(table);
177	                    history.setHandNumber(event.handNumber());
178	                    history.setWinnerUserId(Long.parseLong(entry.getKey()));
179	                    history.setPotAmount(entry.getValue());
180	                    handHistoryRepository.save(history);
181	                });
182	    }
183	
184	    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
185	    public List<HandHistoryResponse> getHandHistory(Long tableId, String username) {
186	        PokerTable table = tableRepository.findById(tableId)
187	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Table not found"));
188	
189	        User user = userRepository.findByUsername(username)
190	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found"));
191	
192	        if (!clubMemberRepository.existsByClubIdAndUserId(table.getClub().getId(), user.getId())) {
193	            throw new IllegalStateException("Access denied");
194	        }
195	
196	        return handHistoryRepository.findByTableIdOrderByHandNumberAsc(tableId).stream()
197	                .map(HandHistoryResponse::from)
198	                .toList();
199	    }
200	
201	    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
202	    public AvailableActionResponse getAvailableActions(Long tableId, String username) {
203	        GameSession session = sessionManager.get(tableId);
204	        if (session == null) {
205	            throw new IllegalStateException("No active game for this table");
206	        }
207	        User user = userRepository.findByUsername(username)
208	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("User not found"));

210	        return AvailableActionResponse.fromState(session.getState(), user.getId().toString());

## Summary: WebSocket and Game-Related Source Files

I've completed a thorough exploration of the FriendlyPoker codebase and found all WebSocket-related and game-related source files. Here's what I discovered:

### 1. WebSocket Configuration

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/config/WebSocketConfig.java`

This is the central WebSocket configuration file with:
- `@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker` annotation enabling STOMP over WebSocket
- Simple broker configured for `/topic` prefix (broadcast messages)
- Application destination prefix set to `/app` (client to server messages)
- STOMP endpoint registered at `/ws` with SockJS fallback support
- CORS allowing all origins (`*` pattern)

**Key WebSocket Paths:**
- `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` - broadcasts game state updates
- `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` - broadcasts game events

---

### 2. Game Controllers (REST APIs for Game Actions)

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/controller/GameController.java`

REST endpoints (not using `@MessageMapping`, so game actions go through REST/HTTP):
- `POST /api/tables/{id}/start-hand` - starts a new hand
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/state` - retrieves current game state
- `POST /api/tables/{id}/action` - processes player actions (fold, check, call, raise, all-in)
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/history` - retrieves hand history
- `GET /api/tables/{id}/actions` - gets available actions for current player

---

### 3. Game Service (Core Game Logic & WebSocket Broadcasting)

**File:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/service/GameService.java`

The service that orchestrates game flow and broadcasts updates:
- Processes player actions via `processAction()` method
- Starts hands via `startHand()` method
- Uses `SimpMessagingTemplate` to broadcast game state and events to WebSocket topics
- Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` after each action
- Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` for game events (excluding HoleCardsDealt for privacy)
- Saves hand history when hands finish
- Manages GameSession lifecycle

---

### 4. Game Session Management

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/game/GameSession.java`

Manages a single table's game state:
- Wraps the GameEngine with synchronization
- Provides methods: `startHand()`, `processAction()`, `getState()`
- Thread-safe state management

**File 2:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/game/GameSessionManager.java`

Manages all active game sessions:
- Uses `ConcurrentHashMap<Long, GameSession>` to store sessions by table ID
- Methods: `getOrCreate()`, `get()`, `remove()`
- Spring `@Component` for dependency injection

---

### 5. Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for Game State & Actions

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/dto/GameStateView.java`

The main DTO sent over WebSocket to clients (represents game state):

```

### 6. Game Domain Models

**File 1:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/action/GameAction.java`

Represents a player action in the game:

    String playerId,
    ActionType type,     // FOLD, CHECK, CALL, RAISE, ALL_IN
    int amount
)
```
- Factory methods: `fold()`, `check()`, `call()`, `raise()`, `allIn()`
- Validation in compact constructor

**File 2:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/event/GameEvent.java`

Sealed interface defining all game events with 15 record implementations:
- `HandStarted` - hand begins
- `HoleCardsDealt` - hole cards dealt to player
- `BlindPosted` - blind posted by player
- `PhaseChanged` - game phase changed (PreFlop → Flop → Turn → River → Showdown)
- `CommunityCardDealt` - community cards revealed
- `PlayerActed` - player made action with amount and chips remaining
- `PlayerFolded` - player folded
- `BettingRoundCompleted` - betting round finished
- `Showdown` - showdown phase with revealed hands and ranks
- `PotAwarded` - pot awarded to winner
- `HandFinished` - hand completed with chip deltas for all players
- `PlayerJoined`, `PlayerLeft`, `PlayerSatOut`, `PlayerTimedOut` - player status events

**File 3:** `/home/textile86/friendlypoker/src/main/java/com/friendlypoker/engine/domain/model/GameState.java`

Core game state model (immutable record):
```java
record GameState(
    String tableId,
    long handNumber,
    GamePhase phase,
    List<PlayerState> players,
    Deck deck,
    Pot pot,
    List<Card> communityCards,
    int dealerIndex,
    int currentPlayerIndex,
    GameConfig config
)
```
- Methods: `findPlayer()`, `currentPlayer()`, `dealer()`, `activePlayers()`, `isBettingRoundComplete()`, etc.
- Immutable with builder-pattern methods like `withPhase()`, `withPlayers()`, `replacePlayer()`

---

### WebSocket Communication Flow

1. **Client connects** → WebSocket handshake at `/ws`
2. **Client subscribes** → Client subscribes to:
   - `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` (game state updates)
   - `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` (game events)
3. **Player action** → Client sends HTTP POST to `/api/tables/{id}/action`
4. **Server processes** → `GameService.processAction()`:
   - Converts `ActionRequest` to `GameAction`
   - Calls `GameSession.processAction()`
   - Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/state` with new `GameStateView`
   - Broadcasts to `/topic/tables/{tableId}/events` with game events
5. **Clients receive** → All subscribed clients receive broadcasted updates

### Important Notes

- **No `@MessageMapping` handlers** - Game actions use traditional REST API (`POST /api/tables/{id}/action`) rather than STOMP message mapping
- **Broadcasting strategy** - Uses `SimpMessagingTemplate.convertAndSend()` to push updates to all clients
- **Privacy handling** - Hole cards only shown to the player who holds them (or all players during showdown)
- **Thread safety** - `GameSession` uses `synchronized` methods to ensure thread-safe state transitions

40	                    boolean isViewer = viewerPlayerId != null && p.id().equals(viewerPlayerId);

42	                            ? p.holeCards().stream().map(CardView::from).toList()

53	                }).toList();

30	
31	        actions.add(new ActionOption("FOLD", 0, "fold"));
32	        if (callAmount == 0) {
33	            actions.add(new ActionOption("CHECK", 0, "check"));
34	        } else {
35	            actions.add(new ActionOption("CALL", callAmount, "Call" + callAmount));
36	        }
37	
38	        int minRaiseTo = state.pot().currentBet() + state.config().bigBlind();
39	        int chipsNeededToRaise = minRaiseTo - current.currentBet();
40	        if (chipsNeededToRaise < current.chips()) {
41	            actions.add(new ActionOption("RAISE", minRaiseTo, "Min raise to " + minRaiseTo));

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Client } from '@stomp/stompjs'
import SockJS from 'sockjs-client'
import { GameStateView } from '../api/game'

function formatEvent(ev: { type: string; data: any }): string {
  const d = ev.data ?? {}
  switch (ev.type) {
    case 'HandStarted': return `✨ Hand #${d.handNumber} started`
    case 'BlindPosted': return `${d.playerId}: ${d.isSmallBlind ? 'SB' : 'BB'} ${d.amount}`
    case 'PlayerActed': return `${d.playerId}: ${(d.actionType ?? '').toLowerCase()} ${d.amount || ''}`
    case 'PhaseChanged': return `→ ${d.newPhase ?? ''}`
    case 'PotAwarded': return `🏆 ${d.playerId} wins ${d.amount}`
    case 'HandFinished': return `--- Hand finished ---`
    default: return ev.type
  }
}

export function useGameSocket(tableId: number, onState: (s: GameStateView) => void) {
  const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false)
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<string[]>([])
  const onStateRef = useRef(onState)

  useEffect(() => { onStateRef.current = onState })

  useEffect(() => {
    const client = new Client({
      webSocketFactory: () => new SockJS('/ws') as any,
      reconnectDelay: 3000,
      onConnect: () => {
        setConnected(true)
        client.subscribe(`/topic/tables/${tableId}/state`, (msg) => {
          onStateRef.current(JSON.parse(msg.body))
        })
        client.subscribe(`/topic/tables/${tableId}/events`, (msg) => {
          const ev = JSON.parse(msg.body)
          const text = formatEvent(ev)
          setEvents((prev) => [text, ...prev].slice(0, 60))
        })
      },
      onDisconnect: () => setConnected(false),
    })
    client.activate()
    return () => { client.deactivate() }
  }, [tableId])

  return { connected, events }
}

```

// ─── Card helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  HEARTS: '♥', DIAMONDS: '♦', CLUBS: '♣', SPADES: '♠',
}
const RANK_DISPLAY: Record<string, string> = {
  TWO: '2', THREE: '3', FOUR: '4', FIVE: '5', SIX: '6',
  SEVEN: '7', EIGHT: '8', NINE: '9', TEN: '10',
  JACK: 'J', QUEEN: 'Q', KING: 'K', ACE: 'A',
}
const isRed = (suit: string) => suit === 'HEARTS' || suit === 'DIAMONDS'

function PlayingCard({ rank, suit }: CardView) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`w-9 h-13 bg-white rounded-md shadow-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center font-bold leading-tight select-none ${isRed(suit) ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-900'}`}
      style={{ width: 36, height: 52 }}
    >
      <span className="text-sm">{RANK_DISPLAY[rank] ?? rank}</span>

}

function CardBack() {

      style={{ width: 36, height: 52 }}
    >
      <span className="text-blue-300 text-lg">★</span>
    </div>
  )
}

// ─── Seat positions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Pos = { left: string; top: string }

const POSITIONS: Record<number, Pos[]> = {
  2: [
    { left: '50%', top: '88%' },
    { left: '50%', top: '4%' },
  ],
  4: [
    { left: '50%', top: '88%' },
    { left: '90%', top: '44%' },
    { left: '50%', top: '4%' },
    { left: '10%', top: '44%' },
  ],
  6: [
    { left: '50%', top: '88%' },
    { left: '85%', top: '74%' },
    { left: '93%', top: '30%' },
    { left: '67%', top: '2%' },

  ],
  9: [

    { left: '76%', top: '80%' },
    { left: '93%', top: '55%' },
    { left: '93%', top: '25%' },
    { left: '75%', top: '4%' },
    { left: '50%', top: '0%' },
    { left: '25%', top: '4%' },
    { left: '7%', top: '25%' },
    { left: '7%', top: '55%' },
  ],
}

function getSeatPos(seatIndex: number, maxPlayers: number): Pos {
  const positions = POSITIONS[maxPlayers] ?? POSITIONS[6]
  return positions[seatIndex % positions.length]
}

// ─── Player seat ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface PlayerSeatProps {
